card.name: Just before a number in millions
card.fires_on: The spot right before or inside a large figure, where the next words are likely to be 'million' or similar big-number units. Seen in general web text about populations, years, memory sizes and casualties.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The gap or word right before digits that will be followed by 'million'.
modes.example: Ethiopia has the largest livestock population in Africa, with approximately<< >>27 million head of cattle, including

modes.label: Inside a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a figure that ends in million.
modes.example: horse was a relatively small dog-like animal known as Eohippus (Hyracotherium) that lived in the Eocene period some <<5>>5 million years ago. In fact,

modes.label: Linking word before a count
modes.description: A small verb or preposition leading into a large population or toll.
modes.example: a brutal campaign of collectivization and man-made famine that<< took>> more than 40 million lives.

card.writes: It boosts big-number unit words like 千万, 亿 and crore and suppresses 万-type units.
card.plain: It fires when a very large count, like millions of people or years, is about to be written.
